rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=3000, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, rationale=iter-4: change EXACTLY ONE knob proj_sr 0.02 -> 0.0005 (40x TIGHTER projection-domain range/attenuation sigma, mirroring the breast-tuned proj_sr=0.0005). Based on iter-1 canonical 6-param config (img_n_bf=proj_n_bf=1, all sigmas at Wagner defaults) so this is a clean single-knob A/B vs iter-1. FAILURE MODE: iters 1-3 all land PSNR ~35.6 dB, ~0.96 dB BELOW the LD-FBP baseline 36.56 dB, hr still 0 -- the dense-view 2304-angle FBP is already near-clean and the bilateral stack is DEGRADING it. iter-3 proved the IMAGE-domain BF is inert: img_sr 0.02->0.005 moved PSNR only 35.597->35.600 (a no-op), so the image BF is not the active over-smoother. That points at the OTHER BF: the projection-domain bilateral filter, which still runs at the aggressive Wagner-abdomen defaults (proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02) BEFORE the FBP, so over-smoothing the sinogram propagates radial/angular blur through the whole reconstruction (~1 dB PSNR loss). Design-doc: proj_sr should be VERY small because sinogram values are line integrals and the proj BF must preserve attenuation edges tightly; at proj_sr=0.02 the range kernel is too wide and the proj BF collapses toward a plain Gaussian that blurs the sinogram. HYPOTHESIS: a 40x-tighter proj_sr=0.0005 makes the projection-domain BF edge-PRESERVING on the line integrals, so it stops blurring the sinogram before FBP, recovering recon PSNR ABOVE the 36.56 dB LD-FBP baseline and lifting hr off 0. Everything else held at iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=6, n_iter=400, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, seed=42, default img sigmas, proj_sx/proj_sy at Wagner defaults). Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394): warm-start pre-pass then per-scan Adam fit on each val scan own measurements, scored by evaluate_calibrated on L277 val. NOT amortized., proj_sr=0.0005
